comment: Create one workflow per case in the Armature dashboard at https://app.armature.tech (Workflows → New, point it at this case's task and the gud or git MCP server). Copy the workflow id into workflow_id, replacing the placeholder. evals/armature_ci.py POSTs /api/armature/v1/workflows/<workflow_id>/runs with Authorization: Bearer $ARMATURE_API_KEY, then polls the run and its /evaluation.
